transitions.why: 767 trades over 262 days, 3 FX symbols, best configuration found: expectancy +0.030R, t=0.40 against a Bonferroni threshold of 2.81 over 10 hypotheses. Fails 3 of 4 lifecycle gates. XAUUSD dropped (gross -2.455R before costs). The source's own range definition rejected across all 5 interpretations. NOTE: this version omits the BIAS TREND filter the source mandates, so it measures an unfiltered superset - a successor implementing bias is a NEW version, not a revision of this one.

SCOPE HARDENED 2026-08-16 on a [TRADER] ruling: there is no NO-TRADE terminal, so BIAS TREND is a direction selector and not a veto. The earlier scope note - that this version measured an unfiltered superset - is VOID. The engine took the trade count the strategy takes. -0.114R/trade over 1030 trades stands as a measurement of the strategy's own behaviour. Open defect remaining is FIX 0: RANGE SETUP unreachable, so bucket composition is still wrong.

SCOPE EXTENDED 2026-08-16 (remediation review): the SETUP PARTITION IS DEGENERATE ON FORK 2. SWEEP 1030/1030, RANGE 0/1030 - 'SWEEP DURING SESSION?' always answers YES because swept = body < session_high is trivially true. Do NOT mine per-bucket results for a SWEEP-vs-RANGE comparison; that comparison class never existed. CORRECTION to the review: fork 1 ('IS RANGE SESSION?') is NOT degenerate - sweeping theta 0.20-0.50 moves TREND 664->326 and SWEEP 148->376 and expectancy -0.043 to +0.042, so A4 has been exercised and TREND-vs-SWEEP is a real 2-way partition. The FIX 3 grid is runnable today; it simply cannot populate RANGE.
